entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit Support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I'm certainly sorry to hear that. I can help. Could I please get your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you, Alex. I see your account here, and it looks like you're a VIP member. I see your recent purchase for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered 16 days ago. To make sure I understand the problem, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's broken. The pulse tracker is inaccurate and it won't sync my workouts properly. It's just a defective product.
I understand your frustration. A tracker that won't sync is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up our return information for you. One moment.

Okay, Alex, I've just checked for you. I see you're well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a full refund for this defective band. There's no need for any further troubleshooting.
Oh. Okay. So you'll send a shipping label?

Yes, of course. And as an apology for the trouble, and since you're one of our VIP members, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for any future VeloFit purchase. I'm emailing you the pre-paid return label right now. You should have it in your inbox.
I see it. A credit is fine. Whatever.
Perfect. Once we receive the tracker, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, Alex?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
